snippet.title: Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216840/Greak_2_Alliance_of_the_Storms/

A world premiere trailer revealed Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms, a stunning cooperative metroidvania set in a land of parallel dimensions. It's coming to PC and consoles in 2027.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
